plan.text:
Add focused regression tests for the existing bulk-discount threshold (subtotal >= 10,000 cents triggers 10% discount for REGULAR customers, per DiscountPolicy.discountRate). Production code will not be changed; only PricingCalculatorTest.java will be extended with three new test methods covering 9,999, 10,000, and 10,001 cents, matching existing test conventions (single Item per test, assertEquals on calculateTotalCents). Then run the relevant tests to confirm correctness.

Implementation steps:
1. Re-confirm threshold logic in /src/main/java/com/sweforge/pricing/DiscountPolicy.java: discountRate returns 0.10 when subtotalCents >= 10_000 and customerTier is not VIP; otherwise 0.0.
2. In /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java, add a test 'justBelowBulkThresholdHasNoDiscount' using a REGULAR order with a single Item(9_999) and assertEquals(9_999, ...) since no discount applies below 10,000.
3. Add a test 'atBulkThresholdGetsBulkDiscount' using a single Item(10_000) and assertEquals(9_000, ...) reflecting the 10% discount applied exactly at the threshold (10_000 * 0.90 = 9_000).
4. Add a test 'justAboveBulkThresholdGetsBulkDiscount' using a single Item(10_001) and assertEquals(9_001, ...) reflecting Math.round(10_001 * 0.90) = 9_001, confirming the discount still applies just above threshold.
5. Keep all new tests using the existing conventions: same package, JUnit 5 @Test annotations, PricingCalculator instance field, List.of(...) for items, default REGULAR tier (no explicit CustomerTier needed since Order(List<Item>) defaults to REGULAR).
6. Do not modify any file under /src/main/java (DiscountPolicy.java, PricingCalculator.java, Item.java, Order.java, CustomerTier.java) — production code stays unchanged.
7. Run the relevant tests: first a targeted run of PricingCalculatorTest (e.g., mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test) under Java 21, then run the full suite with mvn test per repository convention to ensure no regressions.
8. Review test output to confirm all new boundary tests (9,999 / 10,000 / 10,001) pass alongside the existing three tests, with no changes reported outside the test file.

Validation:
- mvn -Dtest=PricingCalculatorTest test passes with 6 total tests (3 existing + 3 new) all green.
- mvn test (full suite) passes with no failures or errors.
- git diff shows changes limited to /src/test/java/com/sweforge/pricing/PricingCalculatorTest.java only; no files under /src/main/java are modified.
- New test expectations match manual computation: 9,999 -> 9,999 (no discount), 10,000 -> 9,000 (10% off), 10,001 -> 9,001 (10% off, rounded).
